contract.name: Arcade
contract.description: Five architecture-themed canvas mini games shown on the blog page while there are no articles: Monolith Breaker, Load Balancer, Circuit Breaker, Merge to Platform, Uptime Runner

mount.description: Builds tabs, canvas and description inside root and starts the render loop

constraints.no_external_dependencies: Canvas 2D only; no libraries, fonts or network requests
constraints.start_policy: Games start only on click / tap / space; nothing autoplays
constraints.performance: Render loop pauses when the arcade is off screen (IntersectionObserver) or the tab is hidden
constraints.routing: Does not touch location.hash (the site uses hash routing for sections)
constraints.storage: Best score per game in localStorage arcade-best-<id>; every access wrapped in try/catch
constraints.theming: Canvas colors from CSS custom properties --arcade-bg/fg/muted/line/stage on .arcade

contract.notes: +++===+++ 2026-11-05 Asia/Baku — Hasan Alizada — Created; loaded on demand by App.mountArcade when articles/index.json is empty
